ui: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally well-designed high-fidelity desktop hotel reception application screen, landscape 16:10, edge-to-edge crisp application UI, no browser frame, no device, no perspective. This is the exact visual reference for a JavaFX school project called HotelSys. Character: calm, precise, welcoming; inspired by a boutique Algerian hotel reception ledger, not a marketing landing page. Typography: Manrope regular/medium for every control and DM Serif Display regular for the page heading only. Palette: neutral porcelain #F6F5F1 page, white cards, aubergine ink #352E3A, secondary gray #757078, terracotta #A94F32 primary action with white text, muted sage #DCE4D8 and muted lavender #E6E1EB used only for reservation statuses. No gradients, no glows, no emoji, no decorative illustrations, no heavy bold. Quiet hairline borders, radius 8 for buttons and 12 for panels. Desktop shell: 232px white sidebar at left, small terracotta arched hotel-door monogram plus HotelSys wordmark at top. French navigation: Tableau de bord, Réservations, Calendrier (selected soft pale terracotta with narrow vertical accent), Clients, Chambres, Caisse, then separated Équipe and Paramètres. Bottom sidebar small avatar circle HA, Heithem, Administrateur, déconnexion. Main content generous 32px padding. Heading Planning des séjours in 34px serif, subtitle Une vue claire de chaque chambre. Top right primary button + Nouvelle réservation. A horizontal toolbar: Novembre 2026, left/right chevrons, Aujourd’hui button, quiet status legend Réservé / En séjour / Terminé. One large white room calendar grid occupies main area: first column Chambre; date columns Lun 23, Mar 24, Mer 25, Jeu 26, Ven 27 (current day pale terracotta header and subtle column tint), Sam 28, Dim 29. Rows room101 Classique 2 lits, 102 Classique 2 lits, 103 Familiale 3 lits, 201 Supérieure 2 lits, 202 Suite 4 lits, 203 Suite 4 lits. Large elegant horizontal reservation bars span dates correctly, sage bars for checked-in, lavender bars for reserved, warm pale gray for completed. Text inside bars realistic French Algerian names: Amine Benali, Sarah Bensaïd, Karim Haddad, Famille Mansouri, Nadia Khelifi; smaller second line 2 adultes, Petit-déj. or 2 adultes · 1 enfant. Empty cells calm and spacious. Fine grid lines and room numbers in Manrope medium. Below grid one quiet compact panel Arrivées du jour with two rows names and room numbers, and a right note Départs du jour with two rows. Data should be plausible demonstration data, no fake growth percentages or random charts. The visual richness is the organized multiday reservation calendar itself, quiet neutral chrome around it. Clear information hierarchy, aligned grid, generous readable typography, impeccable spatial rhythm. Render all labels as precisely as possible in French. This must look directly implementable as JavaFX controls and shapes.
logo: Use case: logo-brand. Create a single extremely simple flat vector-style logo mark for HotelSys, a hotel reception desktop application. One geometric arched hotel doorway, thin terracotta #A94F32 line of uniform width, with an inner arch, straight door jambs and a tiny circular keyhole or door handle, subtly suggesting the letter H through the two jambs. Only the mark, absolutely no text, no wordmark, no shadows, no gradient, no mockup, no texture, no decorative frame. Center a tall architectural arch in the middle of a square transparent canvas, the mark fills roughly 75 percent of canvas height with generous equal margins. Refined boutique hotel stationery feel, clear at small sidebar and window-icon sizes. True transparent background.
